name: 9naŭ
description: The 9naŭ platform for life and business growth.
author: Samuel Aure

scripts.dev:on: docker compose --env-file .env.development up postgres_development -d --build && concurrently "pnpm --filter api run dev:on" "pnpm --filter web run dev:on"
scripts.prod:on: docker compose --env-file .env up postgres -d --build && concurrently "pnpm --filter api run prod:on" "pnpm --filter web run prod:on"
scripts.test:on: docker compose --env-file .env.test up postgres_test -d --build && concurrently "pnpm --filter api run test:on" "pnpm --filter web run test:on"
